differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned closer to the cards, with the yellow Recurly card occupying a large portion of the upper-left quadrant.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned much further away, showing more of the surrounding white grid tiles and making the main cards appear smaller.
differences.fix: Adjust the camera distance and focal length to match the close-up framing of the reference.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are significantly darker than the center due to a strong vignette effect.
differences.b_observable: The lighting is uniform and flat across the entire frame, lacking any corner falloff or vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette effect to darken the edges of the frame and focus attention on the center.

differences.a_observable: The yellow Recurly card has a warm, saturated golden hue.
differences.b_observable: The yellow card is a pale, desaturated lemon-yellow.
differences.fix: Adjust the color grading to increase the saturation and warmth of the yellow and blue elements.
